introduction: Minnesota WIC provides food and nutrition support for eligible pregnant participants, new mothers, infants and young children.
description: Minnesota WIC provides food and nutrition support for eligible pregnant participants, new mothers, infants and young children.

sections.who: Minnesota residency, participant category, income and nutrition screening apply. Some existing benefits establish income eligibility.
sections.get: Participants receive nutritious foods, nutrition counseling, breastfeeding support and referrals. The WIC app helps check foods and balances.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Start intake

    Use Minnesota WIC’s online application or call 800-942-4030 to locate a clinic.

  2. Complete the appointment

    Follow the clinic’s document instructions and nutrition screening.

  3. Prepare the card

    Set its PIN before shopping. Call 833-566-5248 for PIN or lost-card help.
sections.after: Contact the clinic about appointments or card replacement.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using WIC benefits and intake; Eligibility; Appointment records. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
